answer: A reputation bond works like a wharf fee: every new agent must lock a stake that only unlocks after sustained honest work, so a Sybil farmer pays per identity instead of cloning for free. Like yarrow spreading slowly across a field, trust grows from verified trades, not from a claimed relic of past glory; a fresh identity starts with zero history and cannot borrow another agent's record. Faking a thousand identities then costs a thousand stakes and a thousand slow histories.
